Messages.Body:
I pretty sure this is allowed but since it doesn't make that much sense
in the metagame (roleplay, description of imbued etc), I figured I'd
check.

Can Barbaro Lucchese make Imbued infernal?

Barbaro Lucchese
Independent: Barbaro may place a taint counter on a minion as a +1
stealth (D) action. If a minion has 2 taint counters, burn those
counters to make the minion infernal. Barbaro may change his clan to
Tremere antitribu as a +1 stealth action. Infernal.
